idea-plugin.name: Slow Build Hotspots
idea-plugin.description:
Slow Build Hotspots — Find and Fix Gradle Build Bottlenecks

Analyzes your Gradle build profiles to pinpoint slow tasks, cache misses, and non-incremental operations — with actionable optimization recommendations that deliver measurable build time improvements.

Features

  • Profile Parsing — parses the latest Gradle --profile HTML report (build/reports/profile or a custom directory)
  • Hotspot Detection — slow tasks (by share of total build time), cache misses, non-incremental tasks and high configuration time, each with a severity (Critical / Warning / Info) and a concrete suggestion
  • Task Breakdown — sortable table of every task with duration, cache status and incremental flag
  • Trend Tab — bar chart of the slowest tasks, plus average / median / P95 / min / max over your analyzed builds and regressions (builds ≥15% slower than the previous five)
  • Configurable — slow-task and configuration-time thresholds, profile directory and how many builds of history to keep (10–500)

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ or another IntelliJ-based IDE
  • Gradle project with --profile support

Support

  • Issues: GitHub
  • Email: support@jakubjirak.com
